name: Tammy Carpenter

bio.statement: Willamette Week describes Carpenter as an anesthesiologist for two decades.
Ballotpedia says Carpenter earned an M.D. from the University of Chicago in 2003.
bio.excerpt: an M.D. from the University of Chicago in 2003

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Carpenter lists her occupation as retired, with a background as an anesthesiologist and executive board member of the Oregon Society of Anesthesiologists.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Retired Occupational Background: Anesthesiologist, Oregon Society of Anesthesiologists, Executive Board; American Society of Anesthesiologists, Delegate

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Carpenter says she will champion a universal healthcare package covering every Oregonian.
positions.excerpt: will champion a universal healthcare package that guarantees care to every Oregonian.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Carpenter says the state needs to explore social housing.
positions.excerpt: I believe we need to explore social housing.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Carpenter says she plans to introduce a wealth tax to fund universal childcare and schools.
positions.excerpt: I plan to introduce a wealth tax that will fund universal childcare and strong Oregon schools.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Carpenter says schools can be fully funded only with revenue system reform.
positions.excerpt: We must fully fund our schools and we can only do that with revenue system reform

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Carpenter says she will vote only on a transportation package focused on the basics.
positions.excerpt: I will only vote on a transportation package focused on the basics.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, Carpenter says Oregon must uphold its status as a sanctuary state.
positions.excerpt: We must uphold our status as a sanctuary state
